output.explanation: NIG-SA booked AED 26,600 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-019081) against NIG-AE's AED 28,000 secondment invoice AE-ICINV-00836 (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031427), a ratio of 0.95 consistent with Saudi 5% WHT on services; the buyer description explicitly states 'net of WHT 5%'.
